Saturnus 0.12.1 is Saturnus with a capital S: the desktop app on Mac and
Windows, the app and every text that names it. The site explains each
calculator better and has a new page on how Saturnus is built.

## Get it

- **On the web**, nothing to install: <https://ractive.ch/saturnus/app/>
  (Chrome, Edge or Firefox for a serial cable; every browser for the
  emulated calculator).
- **The desktop app** `Saturnus_0.12.1_…` (on Linux `saturnus-app`), with
  a `-SHA256SUMS` file beside them:
  - macOS, Apple silicon: `.dmg`, signed and notarised, or `brew trust
    --cask ractive/tap/saturnus-app` once, then `brew install --cask
    ractive/tap/saturnus-app`. There is no build for Intel Macs: use the
    app in the browser there;
  - Windows: `.msi` or `-setup.exe` for x86_64 (`x64`) and ARM (`arm64`);
  - Linux: `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.AppImage` for x86_64 (`amd64`, `x86_64`)
    and ARM (`arm64`, `aarch64`). Add yourself to the `dialout` group to
    use a serial port.
- **The command-line tools** `saturnus` and `satx`: `cargo install`,
  Homebrew `ractive/tap`, Scoop `ractive`, or the archives and Linux
  packages below.
- **Libraries** on crates.io, all at 0.12.1.

## Saturnus, with a capital S

- **The desktop app is called Saturnus on Mac and Windows**, like the
  other apps in the Applications folder and the Start menu:
  `Saturnus.app`, and the installers are `Saturnus_0.12.1_…`. Settings
  and saved calculators carry over. The new installers replace the old
  app, `brew upgrade` replaces `saturnus.app` with `Saturnus.app`, and a
  new `.msi` upgrades an installed one.
- **Every text that names the product says Saturnus**: the app, the
  installed web app, the desktop app's window and Linux menu entry, the
  command line's messages, the Claude Desktop extension and the READMEs.
  Commands, package names, paths and addresses stay lowercase
  (`saturnus rom fetch`, `saturnus-app`, `/saturnus/app/`).
- **The Claude Desktop extension** recognises the app starting up
  whatever the capitalisation; an extension installed from an earlier
  release needs adding again.

## Your AI

- **A blinking cursor is not a running program.** Right after a key
  opened a command line (a cell of the MatrixWriter, an edit), the tools
  could say "running" and suggest ATTN, which drops what was typed; they
  now look for about 300 ms before calling the calculator busy.
  to_stack's note says what CANCEL would lose in the EquationWriter, the
  MatrixWriter and an edit.

## The site

- **Each model's page answers the questions people ask about it**: where
  the ROM comes from, which computers and phones run it, moving programs
  to a real calculator, saving your work, and how close it is to the
  real one. The landing page has the same for Saturnus as a whole.
- **[How Saturnus is built](https://ractive.ch/saturnus/docs/how-it-is-built/)**,
  for developers: the Rust core, WebAssembly in the browser, the Tauri
  desktop app, the command line, the clean-room method and the tests.
- Page titles say what each page is, and search engines get structured
  data for the app and the questions. A link to the site shows a new
  preview card with all twelve calculators.
